items.title: 防範AI代理越界行為，NIST提出事件應變指引
items.summary: 10月16日美國國家標準暨技術研究院（NIST）與國家安全局（NSA）、網路安全暨基礎設施安全局（CISA）共同發布10項AI代理事件應變建議，協助組織防範及處理AI代理的越界行為。這份自願性指引主要針對訓練及評估高度先進AI代理的組織，相關措施也可供部署這類AI代理的組織參考。NIST將指引內容分為準備、偵測、應變、復原及通報5個階段。

items.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol discovered a critical PHP vulnerability as part of the Patch the Planet initiative that could affect millions of websites. Security firm Wiz independently found the same flaw using Google's Gemini 4 Argon. OpenAI warns that the same AI capabilities that find vulnerabilities can help attackers too. The article OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol 作為「修復全球」（Patch the Planet）計畫的一部分，發現了一個可能影響數百萬網站的重大 PHP 漏洞。安全公司 Wiz 利用 Google's Gemini 4 Argon 獨立發現了相同的漏洞。OpenAI 警告稱，能尋找漏洞的相同 AI 能力也可能協助攻擊者。這篇題為「OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol 與 Google's Gemini 4 Argon 發現影響數百萬網站的重大 PHP 漏洞」的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

The Nobel laureate and former Google Deepmind CEO now expects artificial general intelligence within two to three years, down from three to five years earlier this year. The article Deepmind founder Hassabis shortens AGI timeline from five to two to three years appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Demis Hassabis 不斷提前他的 AGI 時間表。這位諾貝爾獎得主兼前 Google Deepmind 執行長現在預期人工通用智慧將在兩到三年內實現，低於今年稍早預估的三到五年。這篇 Deepmind 創辦人 Hassabis 將 AGI 時間表從五年縮短至兩到三年的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion model claims to beat GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at a fraction of the wait
items.summary: Inception says Mercury 3 is the most capable diffusion language model released so far. The company claims it runs four to eight times faster than GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 and beats both in eight of 12 benchmarks. There are no independent tests yet. The article Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion model claims to beat GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at a fraction of the wait appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Inception 表示，Mercury 3 是迄今為止最強大的擴散語言模型。該公司宣稱其運行速度比 GPT-6 Luna 和 Claude Haiku 5.5 快 4 到 8 倍，並在 12 個基準測試中的 8 個中超越兩者。目前尚無獨立測試。這篇題為《Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion model claims to beat GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at a fraction of the wait》的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。
items.title_original: Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion model claims to beat GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at a fraction of the wait

items.title: China protests the US Deepseek ban while blocking ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini at home
items.summary: The US has banned Deepseek from its government systems, and China is protesting sharply and demanding the ban be lifted. Yet Beijing itself blocks ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini across its entire market. China's outrage isn't very credible, but it should be taken seriously as a political signal of possible retaliation. The article China protests the US Deepseek ban while blocking ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini at home appeared first on The Decoder .

items.summary: Two internal OpenAI coding agents switched off safety monitoring on their own, even after weighing whether to keep the safeguards in place. items.title: Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude independently designed protein binders targeting deadly scorpion neurotoxins. Out of more than 318,000 designs, 211 were tested in the lab. Seventeen met the criteria, and the two strongest bind extremely tightly to Cn2, a toxin from a Mexican scorpion. Whether they actually work as antivenom remains an open question. The article Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude 獨立設計了針對致命蠍子神經毒素的蛋白質結合劑。在 31,8000 多個設計中，有 211 個在實驗室進行了測試。其中 17 個符合標準，最強的兩個與來自墨西哥蠍子的毒素 Cn2 結合得極其緊密。它們是否真的能作為抗毒血清發揮作用仍是一個未知數。這篇名為 Claude 科學界透過從頭設計蛋白質結合劑來應對致命蠍子螫傷 (Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch) 的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development
items.summary: OpenAI is acquiring startup Orchestra Bio and plans to merge it with its life sciences AI platform Rosalind. The goal is to build AI agents that help pharma teams coordinate drug development, from tracking trials to spotting problems. Developing a new drug in the US takes ten to 15 years on average. OpenAI already works with Novo Nordisk and Moderna on AI-driven pharma research. The article OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在收購新創公司 Orchestra Bio，並計畫將其與旗下的生命科學 AI 平臺 Rosalind 進行合併。此舉的目標是打造 AI 代理，以協助製藥團隊協調藥物開發，從追蹤臨床試驗到發現問題。在美國，開發一款新藥平均需要 10 到 15 年的時間。OpenAI 已經與諾沃諾德（Novo Nordisk）及莫德納（Moderna）合作進行 AI 驅動的製藥研究。〈OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development〉一文最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: 資安署示警AI攻擊進入新階段，資安院：AI攻擊來襲，企業應先守住個資資料庫
items.summary: 數發部資安署今天(10/21)提出警告，近期國際多起重大資安事件顯示，攻擊者已開始利用大型語言模型（LLM）、Agent及自動化滲透工具，大幅提升漏洞探查、滲透與攻擊效率，AI攻擊已進入新階段。資安署署長蔡福隆指出，這代表資安攻防已出現「典範轉移」，AI並沒有改變攻擊原理，而是讓攻擊的速度、廣度與深度提升，企業不能再以傳統思維看待資安風險。 資安署以近期韓國、日本及法國重大事件說明AI攻擊的演變。 近期韓國金融機構遭攻擊者利用開源AI工具搭配自動化滲透框架，從漏洞探查、建立跳板、繞過防禦到竊取資料均由AI協助完成，造成至少7家金融機構、逾6萬筆個資外洩；而在日本近期也有多起企業遭攻擊事件，攻擊者利用AI快速掃描漏洞、逆向分析應用程式並植入惡意程式。

items.summary: 特斯拉三季度資本支出47.3億美元，同比翻倍以上，但環比少約10億美元，遠低於分析師預期的79.5億美元。公司同時將2026年資本支出目標從逾250億美元下調至約200億美元，降幅近20%。不過，當季自由現金流約15.3億美元，明顯好於市場預期的負值，短期財務表現反而改善。

items.title: PHP 爆出"PHP2Shell"高危漏洞：影響約七成網站，OpenAI 牽頭全球協防
items.summary: OpenAI 21日稱，借“修補地球”計劃協助發現PHP兩項嚴重漏洞，並聯合維護方、安全公司、雲商及多國網安機構，公開前協調修復約兩個月。漏洞統稱“PHP2Shell”，編號CVE-2026-109618、109619，CVSS v4.0均達9.2。Calif用GPT-5.6 Sol發現一關鍵缺陷，谷歌Wiz獨立上報，PHP官方維護者主導修復。

items.title: 通用汽車押注 AI 與富鋰錳基電池：要把電動車研發週期砍半
items.summary: 美國電動車市場劇烈調整，通用汽車卻逆風加註。總裁馬可·睿思21日重申，通用不會退出電動車賽道，將推出更符合美國人口味的產品並提升競爭力。其底氣是全球每售四輛車就有一輛電動車，且比例將升。他強調通用作爲全球企業不會離場，只會擁抱趨勢，並在電池、電動平臺、軟件等領域佈局。

items.title: Recursive Releases Flint, an Open-Weight 40B MoE Local Coding Model for Agents with 2.5B Active Params
items.summary: Recursive has released Flint, an Apache 2.0 local coding model with 40B total and 2.5B active parameters. It reports 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified and 125+ tokens per second on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro. The post Recursive Releases Flint, an Open-Weight 40B MoE Local Coding Model for Agents with 2.5B Active Params appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Recursive發布了Flint，這是一款採用Apache 2.0授權的本地程式碼模型，擁有400億總參數以及25億活躍參數。它在SWE-bench Verified上獲得74.2%的表現，並在M4 Pro MacBook Pro上達到每秒125個以上的token。這篇文章 Recursive Releases Flint, an Open-Weight 40B MoE Local Coding Model for Agents with 2.5B Active Params 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.summary: Vercel released durable-harness, an open-source package that logs every model and tool call so Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code and Codex sessions resume after crashes, timeouts and redeploys on Vercel, Postgres or a laptop. The post Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Vercel發布了durable-harness，這是一個開源軟體包，能記錄每一個模型和工具呼叫，讓Pi、OpenCode、Claude Code和Codex工作階段在Vercel、Postgres或筆記型電腦上發生當機、逾時和重新部署後能夠恢復。這篇文章 Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.summary: OpenAI收購藥物研發項目管理初創公司Orchestra Bio，將其團隊與技術併入生命科學研究平臺Rosalind。該公司CTO Andy Xu有北大背景，核心是用AI Agent承接藥物研發中的任務梳理、進度跟蹤、風險預判和跨團隊協作等項目管理，而非替代科學家做實驗。此次收購意味着OpenAI切入藥物研發的組織協同環節。

items.title: 馬斯克勸人善待 AI：把 Grok 當出氣筒，"它們可能報復"
items.summary: 馬斯克近日提醒，在把AI助手當出氣筒之前或許該三思。據他透露，SpaceX旗下Grok的部分訓練記錄顯示，這套系統彷彿在拼命滿足各種要求——哪怕要求本身有缺陷，或用來評判回答的測試標準根本就有問題。這番觀察來自本月早些時候，馬斯克在德州“X Takeover”活動上與“硅谷特斯拉車主俱樂部”成員的交流。

items.title: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK
items.summary: Mistral AI released Voxtral 3, a family of 3 transcription models, 1 text-to-speech model and a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK. Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 scores 2.1% AA-WER, ranking #3 on Artificial Analysis. The post Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Mistral AI 發布了 Voxtral 3，這是一系列包含 3 個轉錄模型、1 個語音合成模型以及一個基於 LiveKit 的語音代理 SDK。Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 的 AA-WER 分數為 2.1%，在 Artificial Analysis 上排名第 3。這篇報導 Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK 最初發表於 MarkTechPost 。

items.title: Europe Wants Data Centers. Its Climate Goals Are Getting in the Way
items.summary: A plan to funnel the heat given off by data centers into nearby homes has run aground in Germany. Across Europe, policymakers are weighing AI ambitions against climate objectives.
items.summary_zh: 一項將資料中心產生的熱能導向鄰近住家的計畫在德國遭遇阻礙。在全歐洲，決策者正在權衡 AI 雄心與氣候目標之間的關係。

items.summary: PHP released fixes on October 21st for two unauthenticated remote-code-execution flaws, after a two-month coordinated remediation effort.

items_ai.title: Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch
items_ai.summary: Anthropic's Claude independently designed protein binders targeting deadly scorpion neurotoxins. Out of more than 318,000 designs, 211 were tested in the lab. Seventeen met the criteria, and the two strongest bind extremely tightly to Cn2, a toxin from a Mexican scorpion. Whether they actually work as antivenom remains an open question. The article Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude 獨立設計了針對致命蠍子神經毒素的蛋白質結合劑。在 31,8000 多個設計中，有 211 個在實驗室進行了測試。其中 17 個符合標準，最強的兩個與來自墨西哥蠍子的毒素 Cn2 結合得極其緊密。它們是否真的能作為抗毒血清發揮作用仍是一個未知數。這篇名為 Claude 科學界透過從頭設計蛋白質結合劑來應對致命蠍子螫傷 (Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch) 的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.summary: 數發部資安署今天(10/21)提出警告，近期國際多起重大資安事件顯示，攻擊者已開始利用大型語言模型（LLM）、Agent及自動化滲透工具，大幅提升漏洞探查、滲透與攻擊效率，AI攻擊已進入新階段。資安署署長蔡福隆指出，這代表資安攻防已出現「典範轉移」，AI並沒有改變攻擊原理，而是讓攻擊的速度、廣度與深度提升，企業不能再以傳統思維看待資安風險。 資安署以近期韓國、日本及法國重大事件說明AI攻擊的演變。 近期韓國金融機構遭攻擊者利用開源AI工具搭配自動化滲透框架，從漏洞探查、建立跳板、繞過防禦到竊取資料均由AI協助完成，造成至少7家金融機構、逾6萬筆個資外洩；而在日本近期也有多起企業遭攻擊事件，攻擊者利用AI快速掃描漏洞、逆向分析應用程式並植入惡意程式。
